item.title: Jeremy Bowen: Trump is waging war based on instinct and it isn't working
item.summary: One month into the conflict in Iran, Trump's gut-instinct approach is not proving effective, writes the BBC's international editor.

item.title: Hundreds in Beirut mourn journalists killed in Israeli strike
item.summary: BBC reports from the funerals of three journalists killed by a targeted attack in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Iran says its forces 'waiting' as US troops arrive in region
item.summary: US officials have not confirmed if ground troops will be deployed in the conflict, which would escalate the war.

item.title: Iranian attacks across Gulf continue as major industrial sites hit
item.summary: A number of people are said to have been injured after attacks on aluminium sites in the UAE and Bahrain.

item.title: Three arrested in Paris after attempted bomb attack outside Bank of America
item.summary: France's anti-terrorism prosecutor's office said it had immediately taken over the investigation.

item.title: Counter-terror police join Derby car incident investigation
item.summary: Police question a man, 36, and keep an "open mind" as counter‑terror officers join investigation.

item.title: Man, 26, shot dead in car near London Euston station
item.summary: Police say CCTV showed he was shot at several times by a suspect who arrived and left on a bike.

item.title: Potential Houthi threat to Red Sea shipping could further damage global economy
item.summary: The Iran-backed group could bring a second crucial waterway to a standstill, writes Sebastian Usher.

item.title: Murder inquiry victim found in Leeds street identified as 16-year-old girl
item.summary: The teenager found unconscious in Leeds was a teenager from Cleckheaton, police say.

item.title: A simple invitation to bring cake led to a worldwide trend - now Sydney's getting a slice
item.summary: Hundreds of bakers head to the city's botanic gardens to share and savour their colourful creations.
